name: n8n
desc: Workflow automation platform. Runs in Docker, accessible via SSH tunnel or reverse proxy.

postInstall.note: n8n is running on port ${N8N_PORT} (localhost only). Open it with: ssh -L ${N8N_PORT}:127.0.0.1:${N8N_PORT} root@<server-ip>  then visit http://localhost:${N8N_PORT}

form.label: Encryption key
form.hint: Random secret used to encrypt credentials. Save this — you will need it to restore backups.
